name: ROAD_HUMP_AHEAD_YELLOW_DIAMOND

nsw_w3-4_hump_arrow.desc: road hump (R400 dome on a 973 x 90 base, 294 tall) with an up arrow 400 x 350 above it (symbol detail dimensioned on the sheet)

notes: TfNSW design plan (Roads & Maritime 2019 style, upright A3 sheet). 1200 diamond (side 1200, bounding square 1697.06), R80, yellow edge 16, black border 32 (the sheet's 16 and 48 marks at the tips; measured 16 / 36). Symbol 980 x 794 at 361 / 253 (ink box measured on the sheet's sign from the diamond's bounding square; the red-bar symbols' boxes take the red bar's measured extent, which is longer than the arrows; the bus box is the traced extent), traced from the sheet's sign. Sheet W3-4 (RMS 2019): A 600 and B 750 are the AS 1743 W3-4A/B, C 900 and D 1200 the NSW W3-4n(C)/(D); D generated. Arrow 400 wide x 350 (head 200 x 400, shaft 130, R13 barbs), hump 973 x 294 with the R400 dome 138 from each end and a 90 base; 592 from the top tip to the arrow tip, 101 from the hump to the bottom tip.
